title: Infrasys-AI/AIInfra: A broad learning map for AI infrastructure
friendlyTitle: AIInfra explains the technology underneath large AI models
summary: AIInfra is a Chinese-language educational repository spanning AI clusters, storage, communication, training, inference, data and algorithms. Its notebooks and technical notes map the stack from hardware through large-model training and serving, and it had about 7,800 GitHub stars when reviewed.
friendlySummary: This Chinese-language project covers the hardware and software used to train and run large AI models. It had about 7,800 stars on GitHub.
whyItMatters: Infrastructure engineers can use the project as a syllabus for understanding how chips, distributed systems and software fit together in AI workloads. Browser translation can help non-Chinese readers, while the diagrams and notebooks provide useful technical entry points.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it as a study plan for AI servers, storage, training and inference. Translation tools can help readers who do not speak Chinese.
